description: Phase 3.1 canonical types + Phase 3.2 planPipeline state machine + Phase 3.3 Promise.allSettled for cleaner + Phase 4 B5 move fonts to IDB + Phase 5 B16 token tracking per engine + Phase 5 B10 rewrite DownloadCanvas.
steps: STEP 1 - Canonical types (3.1): In types.ts, add a canonical EngineId union type (matching the one in pipelineApi.ts). Add an Engine interface with id, label, capabilities[], pricing?. Add capability type aliases (OcrCapability, TranslateCapability, ImageOutCapability). Export all from types.ts. Update store/useTranslatorStore.ts to import EngineId from types.ts instead of defining its own. Update store/index.ts barrel to re-export from types.ts if needed. Update services/api/pipelineApi.ts to import EngineId from types.ts. Update features/translator/useTranslatePipeline.ts to remove the `as ApiEngineId` cast since EngineId is now shared.

STEP 2 - planPipeline state machine (3.2): Create a new file features/translator/planPipeline.ts. Define a PipelineStep discriminated union with kinds: 'unified-gemini' (model:string), 'image-engine' (engine:EngineId for Torii ocr+trans+render), 'ocr-only' (engine:EngineId), 'translate-only' (engine:EngineId), 'inpaint-cleaner' (engine:EngineId). Export function planPipeline(ocr: EngineId, trans: EngineId, opts: { useToriiForCleaning: boolean }): PipelineStep[]. Logic: if ocr===trans and is a Gemini variant -> unified-gemini step. If ocr==='TORII' or trans==='TORII' -> image-engine step. Otherwise -> ocr-only step + translate-only step. If opts.useToriiForCleaning and no image-engine step -> add inpaint-cleaner step. In useTranslatePipeline.ts, import planPipeline and call it at the top of runPipeline to log/document the plan (the actual API call doesn't change since the BFF handles planning, but the frontend now has the explicit plan for debugging/UI purposes). Add the plan to the pipeline request if the PipelineRequest type has a plan field, or just use it internally for the Promise.allSettled logic in step 3.

STEP 3 - Promise.allSettled for cleaner (3.3): In useTranslatePipeline.ts, refactor the runPipeline function. When planPipeline indicates both ocr+translate AND inpaint-cleaner steps, use Promise.allSettled to run the main pipeline call. The current API already handles cleaner via the `cleaner` field. Modify the approach: when wantsCleaner is true, do NOT include cleaner in the main request. Instead, fire two parallel calls: (a) main pipeline without cleaner, (b) a cleaner-only call. Wait with Promise.allSettled. If cleaner fails, log a warning but still use the OCR+translate result. If cleaner succeeds, use its cleanedImageBase64. NOTE: If the BFF doesn't support a separate cleaner endpoint, then the alternative approach is: keep the single request but wrap it so that if the response has a cleaner warning/error we still proceed. Looking at the pipelineApi.ts, the backend already returns `warnings` array and `cleanedImageBase64` separately. The simplest approach matching the requirement: keep single API call with cleaner.enabled=true, but if the response indicates cleaner failure (no cleanedImageBase64 but warnings present about cleaner), treat it as non-fatal. Actually check the backend to see if cleaner failure already comes back as a warning. If so, this is already handled. If not, we may need a try/catch approach. Given the backend likely returns partial success, add explicit handling in runPipeline: if response.warnings contains cleaner-related messages, log them as console.warn but do not throw. This is already partially done. Ensure cleanedImageBase64 absence doesn't cause issues (it currently falls through gracefully). Document the intent clearly in code comments.

STEP 4 - Move custom fonts to IndexedDB (B5): Modify services/imageStorage.ts to add a 'fonts' object store in the DB upgrade (bump DB_VERSION to 2, handle onupgradeneeded for both version 1->2 migration). Add exported functions: saveFontToIDB(font: StoredFont), loadAllFontsFromIDB(): Promise<StoredFont[]>, deleteFontFromIDB(name: string). In store/useFontsStore.ts, change the persist storage from localStorage (createJSONStorage(() => localStorage)) to a custom storage adapter that uses IndexedDB via the new functions. The custom storage should implement getItem (load all fonts from IDB), setItem (save all fonts to IDB), removeItem (clear fonts from IDB). Keep the same external API (addFont, removeFont, registerLoadedFonts). Add a migration in the store: on first load, check if old localStorage key 'mangalens-fonts' exists, read it, write fonts to IDB, then delete the localStorage key.

STEP 5 - Token tracking per engine (B16): In features/translator/useTokenTracker.ts, add a tokensByEngine map to the state: Record<string, { input: number; output: number; cost: number }>. In handleTokenUsage, extract the engine from the TokenUsage (add engine?: string to the TokenUsage interface in pipelineApi.ts if not present, or derive it from the model string). Update the map: tokensByEngine[engine] += new counts. Export tokensByEngine from the hook. Update the TokenTracker interface to include tokensByEngine.

STEP 6 - Rewrite DownloadCanvas (B10): In components/MangaViewer.tsx, rewrite the handleDownload function to properly replicate the DOM render. Steps: (a) Pre-load fonts with `await document.fonts.ready` or `document.fonts.load()` for each unique font in bubbles. (b) For each bubble, apply rotation using ctx.save()/ctx.translate(centerX,centerY)/ctx.rotate(rad)/ctx.restore(). (c) Replicate text-shadow by drawing text 4x offset (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) in white before drawing the main text in the bubble color. (d) Replace ctx.roundRect with ctx.beginPath + manual arc calls for rounded corners (better browser compatibility). (e) Respect textTransform (uppercase) before drawing by transforming the string. (f) Use the effectiveLineHeight, effectiveScale, effectiveRotation values consistent with BubbleOverlay rendering. (g) Handle the isBubbleTransparent and sfx type correctly.
acceptance_criteria: types.ts exports EngineId, Engine, OcrCapability, TranslateCapability, ImageOutCapability
useTranslatorStore.ts imports EngineId from types.ts (no local redefinition)
features/translator/planPipeline.ts exists with planPipeline function and PipelineStep union
useTranslatePipeline.ts calls planPipeline for internal documentation/debugging
Cleaner failure is handled gracefully (warnings logged, not thrown)
services/imageStorage.ts has DB_VERSION=2 with fonts store and font CRUD functions
useFontsStore.ts uses custom IDB storage adapter instead of localStorage
useTokenTracker.ts tracks tokensByEngine and exports it
MangaViewer handleDownload uses ctx.save/translate/rotate, draws text-shadow offsets, uses arc for rounded corners, respects textTransform
`npm run typecheck && npm run build` passes
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run build
findings: All 6 steps implemented and verified. Typecheck and build pass cleanly. EngineId is now a single canonical type in types.ts. planPipeline.ts provides frontend pipeline planning. Cleaner failure gracefully retries without cleaner. Fonts now stored in IndexedDB (DB_VERSION 2) with localStorage migration. Token tracker includes per-engine breakdown. handleDownload uses rotation, text-shadow, arc-based rounded rects, font preloading, and textTransform.
